articles.headline: UEFA, Concacaf call on Infantino to make $10m payments to all FIFA members
articles.description: FIFA's member federations should each get an extra $10 million (£7.4m) from its swelling cash reserves after a successful World Cup, the soccer body's vice presidents from Europe and North America said in a letter Friday

articles.headline: Sources: English FA chief demands documents on FIFA World Cup sell-off plan, Balogun decision
articles.description: FIFA vice president and FA chairwoman Debbie Hewitt has demanded FIFA president Gianni Infantino release all documents concerning his proposal for private investors to buy stakes in the World Cup, sources told ESPN.
